variant_reviews.comparison: Use the sub-sigma-algebra generated by x restricted to S_star, not all observed covariates. The source model says the conditional mean equals beta_star dot x almost surely; this requires the correct sub-sigma-algebra and integrability before using condExp, whose fallback is zero otherwise. Define each observed residual y_i-beta_star dot x_i directly. These are true-coefficient residuals, not fitted empirical residuals; conditioning on all coordinates would incorrectly remove possible correlations with spurious variables. The selected condExp version need only agree almost surely, so do not assert equality at every sample-space point without selecting a compatible version.
